name: TC-674: a legacy create (no dealType, no roles) reads back as a COMBO of INCLUDED rows with no percent
description: Every client that predates guided deal types (ordering apps, POS, older dashboards) sends no dealType and no item roles. That body still creates a deal: dealType COMBO, discountPercent null, every row INCLUDED, the owner's dealPrice kept. Post-deploy run.
